title: Correction to: Temperature-mediated changes in the force balance of the micropylar region adjust overcoming of dormancy to seasonality in diaspores of the Neotropical palm Butia capitata
content: This is a correction to: Túlio Gabriel Soares Oliveira, Anne Caroline Ferreira Moura, Ludmila Nayara de Freitas Correia, Alcinei Mistico Azevedo, Paulo Sérgio Nascimento Lopes, Leonardo Monteiro Ribeiro, Temperature-mediated changes in the force balance of the micropylar region adjust overcoming of dormancy to seasonality in diaspores of the Neotropical palm Butia capitata, Annals of Botany, 2026, mcag039, https://doi.org/10.1093/aob/mcag039
